name: Development (OpenUP Capability Pattern)
description: EPF/OpenUP's Development (Design & Implementation) capability pattern, modelled as a Pack: the Developer role, its implementation/build work products, and the tasks for designing, implementing, and integrating a solution increment.

capabilities.name: Solution Development
capabilities.description: Designs and implements solution increments against the approved architecture, on behalf of the Developer role.

services.name: Implementation Elements
services.contractDescription: Working code implementing the design for this increment, ready for integration.

services.name: Integrated Build
services.contractDescription: A build integrating this increment's implementation elements, ready for test.

checklists.statement: The design for this increment is consistent with the Architecture Notebook.
checklists.prompt: Does the increment's design follow the approved architecture and design elements?

checklists.statement: The implementation satisfies its design and passes unit-level checks.
checklists.prompt: Run the unit-level checks for this increment and report pass/fail with notes.

checklists.statement: Implementation elements have been integrated into a build without regressions.
checklists.prompt: Run the integration build and report pass/fail with notes.
